name: Immigrate to Rio Grande do Norte
description: Rio Grande do Norte is a Brazilian state in the Northeast Region, known for its beaches, dunes, tourism-driven economy with petroleum extraction, and festivals like Carnatal and Festa Junina. It features landmarks such as Forte dos Reis Magos and natural attractions including Rocas Atoll.
